implementation: performance.py adds frozen RelayPerformanceSample (validated tenant_id/duration_seconds/published_count/failed_count), frozen TenantP95Row, frozen RelayPerformanceBaseline, and summarize_relay_performance(samples): pure reduction over a nonempty sequence of exact RelayPerformanceSample values, never mutates input, uses no ambient clock/database/logging; nearest-rank percentile ceil(q*n); wall_clock_seconds is the sum of already-measured sample durations, seconds_per_published is that sum divided by published_total (0.0 when published_total is zero); per_tenant_p95 is an immutable tuple sorted by tenant_id; fairness_ratio is measured-only min(per-tenant p95)/max(per-tenant p95), 1.0 when the maximum is zero
scenarios: hostile pure percentile/validation contract on 20 synthetic samples; clean-then-empty observed relay pass sequence [5,0,0] yields honest measured aggregates; identity-level tenant ID allow-set isolation over interleaved two-tenant progress [3,3,3,3] reports a measured fairness ratio; no concurrency, noisy-neighbor, or SLA claim is made
scope: one pure, additive performance-summary module over already-measured RelayPerformanceSample readings
nonGoals: no scheduler, retry, DLQ, exporter, dashboard, alert, live host, optimizer, load generator, dollar cost, noisy-neighbor or SLA/readiness claim; no change to P18/P19 modules or exports
